source_listing_evidence.files_section_scope: Only current unretained URLs, source-only sample bundles, and alternate official question-audio packages are enumerated; retained exact primary files are summarized by listing hashes.

native_material_identity_recheck.bank_level_boundary: Download title/native covers identify 2018–2022 elementary-only resources, separate from the 2023 onward shared basic/elementary format. Legacy event and canonical keys remain compatibility selectors.
native_material_identity_recheck.dialect_boundary: Five supported source dialects are separate content variants. Two byte-proven cross-dialect label conflicts are isolated in review under catalog/mappings/hakka/native-conflicts-v1.json.
native_material_identity_recheck.immutable_history_projection: All 56 immutable revisions are projected without changing source facts. Ten checksum/title/source-key-backed legacy ODS labels resolve to the same-edition shared basic/elementary grade. The ungraded all-level rules package remains reference evidence requiring non-paper treatment; no current publication is added.
native_material_identity_recheck.material_boundary: 題庫 resources are question banks; bank-plus-sample PDFs are practice collections; pure samples remain samples. Annual labels identify source editions, not administered sittings.
native_material_identity_recheck.remaining: Full historical native content, non-paper treatment of the historical all-grade standards reference, official resolution of two source dialect conflicts, three source ZIPs above the normal 1.9 GB multipart target and audiovisual redistribution remain unresolved. Hakka publication/public mirror backup holds are unchanged.
native_material_identity_recheck.review_scope: Material type/date and native grade/dialect boundaries; cover/initial worksheet/member metadata review is not full-body linguistic or rights clearance.

secondary_audio_review.text_scope: All six bank worksheets, preserving cell columns and repeated cells; not linguistic or redistribution clearance.
